title: TableSchema
description: A table for @future-standard-ui/table. Plain JSON: string accessor paths, cell type names, CSS lengths. Anything that needs a function is a runtime option, not schema. Mirrors packages/table-core/src/schema.ts; validated at runtime by validateSchema().

id.description: Stable identifier for persistence and saved views. Emitted as data-table-id.

rowKey.description: Dot path to a value unique per row, e.g. "id" or "meta.uuid". Selection and expansion are keyed by it.

Breakpoint.description: Container-width breakpoints of the table itself (not the viewport): sm 480px, md 720px, lg 960px, xl 1200px.

id.description: Unique within the table. Also the default accessor.

header.description: Display text, already translated. May be empty for icon/action columns.

accessor.description: Dot path into the row, e.g. "location.route", "tags.0". Defaults to id.

sortable.description: Header becomes a sort control; the table emits sorting changes.

emphasis.description: Visual weight. The high-emphasis column becomes the card title in the stacked layout.

width.description: CSS length ("200px", "20%", "12rem"). Acts as a floor: the table scrolls rather than squeezing declared columns.

maxWidth.description: CSS length. Pinned columns are locked to width automatically.

pin.description: Lock to an edge while the body scrolls. Pinned columns cannot have visibleFrom/visibleUntil; every pinned column except the outermost on its side must declare width.

visibleFrom.description: Render only at this container breakpoint and above.

visibleUntil.description: Render only below this breakpoint (exclusive). Must be larger than visibleFrom. Pair with visibleFrom on sibling columns for a combined-on-small layout.

group.description: Header group title; adjacent columns with the same title merge. Grouped columns must share visibleFrom/visibleUntil.

type.description: Renderer name. Built in: text, composite. Standard set (@future-standard-ui/table-cells): number, bytes, duration, boolean, timestamp, multiline, status, thumbnail, link, actions, switch, progress, truncate, icon. Projects may register more. Unknown types fall back to text.

options.description: Passed to the renderer untouched. See docs/components/table/cells.md for each type's options.

Condition.description: JSON-safe test against the row, used by actions/switch options (enabledWhen, visibleWhen).

expandable.description: Rows get a toggle and a drawer (content supplied at runtime via renderDrawer).

grouping.description: Group adjacent rows by a column's value. Pass data sorted by that column.

stacked.description: Below this container breakpoint, rows render as cards (mobile layout).
